about.title: About me
about.intro: Hello, I'm Houinlindjonon Alain Wilfried, frontend developer and UI/UX designer at your service.
about.paragraph1: As a frontend developer, I commit to respecting strict criteria such as design, optimization, improvement, and maintenance of quality sites or applications, while ensuring the proper functioning of the mechanics (API) intended for them. With my experience and the many challenges I have overcome, I am confident that I can successfully meet these requirements.
about.paragraph2: As a UI/UX designer, I have recently started working on web and mobile application design projects. I am confident that my design skills will allow me to create user-friendly, intuitive and aesthetically pleasing user interfaces.
about.paragraph3: I am a resident of Côte d'Ivoire, more precisely Abidjan, and I am able to offer you a pleasant, simple and optimized platform that will meet all your requirements, whether you are based in Côte d'Ivoire or anywhere in the world.
